answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, honestly validated service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust factorization propagates credit only through trusted reciprocity; freshly spawned Sybil identities therefore have near-zero eigenvector centrality, even when linked in a basalt, hollow, or timber ring, and cannot accumulate enough weighted support to pass consensus.
